617:t_040:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know that! But I won't let you spout trash like 'revenge is futile'!」

617:t_040:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's not what I mean, $$バルビエル$$! Creating something is stronger than hatred that takes something away!」

617:t_040:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And you, who couldn't find that...」

617:t_040:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$セツコ$$! Don't look at me with those eyes!」

617:t_040:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you can't, then kill me! Try to stop this $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$!」

617:t_040:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's your weakness! But my hatred is infinite! I'll come back to kill every one of you, without fail!」

617:t_041:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That guy...! Saying whatever he likes!」

617:t_041:2.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$セツコ$$. If he comes back, all of us will just face him again.」

617:t_041:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$バルビエル$$... Until the day your hatred reaches its end, I will keep fighting you.)

617:t_042:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
(So $$バルビエル$$ is finished... The power of his $$スフィア$$ won't grow any further...)

617:t_043:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
(How pitiful, $$バルビエル$$. I can't hand that $$スフィア$$ over to your self-indulgence.)

617:t_044:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice work, $c. To push my elite of the $$ハイアデス$$ this far.」

617:t_044:1.en:
$$葵$$
「So you've come out, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

617:t_044:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'll blast you, the Supreme Commander, and crush the Empire right here!」

617:t_044:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I get that we both carry burdens, but...」

617:t_044:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「For now, forget all that and have a total blast! Darling, $c!」

617:t_044:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Forget it! Let's settle this right now, $$エルーナルーナ$$!!」

617:t_045:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like losing your underlings lit a fire under you, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

617:t_045:3.en:
$$桂$$
「It's the decisive battle and he is still doing business as usual... He's as charmless as ever, that fellow.」

617:t_045:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Leave him be, $$桂$$. Whatever his circumstances are, we don't care.」

617:t_045:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We just take this guy down fast and drag $$アウストラリス$$ out!」

617:t_045:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...Impossible. Not for the likes of you.」

617:t_046:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're fools. Do you want me to execute you that badly?」

617:t_046:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A foolish strategy, $$新地球皇国$$. Bound by petty turf consciousness, you commit your forces piecemeal.」

617:t_046:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's not it, $$ゼロ$$. The other two were afraid of getting caught up in my poison.」

617:t_046:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And as long as I'm here, I can dispose of every one of you.」

617:t_046:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... let's keep our promise from $$メガラニカ$$. Taste all of my hatred!」

617:t_046:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Bring it on! We're settling this today, so don't you run!」

617:t_046:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll answer for the anger of everyone your cowardly ways have tormented!」

617:t_046:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you fight out of the personal emotion called hatred, all the better! I can repay my debt without holding back!」

617:t_046:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! Today I end my fight with you!」

617:t_100:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The day has finally come, Darling!」

617:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$! Are you coming at us in anger over $$ダバラーン$$ getting beaten?!」

617:t_100:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nothing like that! The $$ハイアデス$$ live in battle and die in battle!」

617:t_100:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I bet $$ダバラーン$$ was satisfied too! Fighting men like you, Darling!」

617:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「And you? Are you satisfied with that too?!」

617:t_100:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Of course! But I want an even higher satisfaction!」

617:t_100:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And that, Darling, is scoring a victory!」

617:t_100:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Too bad, $$エルーナルーナ$$! No matter how strong your desire is, that wish is out!」

617:t_100:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just for today, I'll play by your rules! I'll go all the way!!」

617:t_101:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll kill you...! That is my love, $$セツコ$$!」

617:t_101:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「No, $$バルビエル$$. That is not love or anything like it.」

617:t_101:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「People can't live on hatred alone! That is the last thing I can teach you!」

617:t_102:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's the decisive battle, $$尸空#pilot$$. Say something.」

617:t_102:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... You put on airs of nihility, but you can't hide your will to kill me.」

617:t_102:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Nihility is not nothing. I too am alive.」

617:t_102:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heard something good at last. That'll get me fired up.」

617:t_102:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Taking on a silent killing machine isn't my idea of fun...!」

617:t_102:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$尸空#pilot$$! I'll show you that not even your nihility can swallow my will to pay off my debt!」

617:t_103:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I believe it's misplaced to direct your anger at me.」

617:t_103:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I know that perfectly well! But...!」

617:t_103:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Before I take down the master you lot serve, let me settle things in my own heart!」

617:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Well then, laugh or cry, this is the last battle on this planet!」

617:t_104:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Let's enjoy it to the fullest, $c! With the best battle ever!」

617:t_105:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Every last one of you...! Do you live just to irritate me?!」

617:t_105:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then I'll erase you! Everything but me, with the poison of $$アン・アーレス$$!!」

617:t_106:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Today, everything ends and everything begins...」

617:t_107:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」
